prompt: We're rolling out the multi-GPU interpretability fix and want to loop in the right teams. Lukas's circuit-tracer message about the OOM errors already got acknowledged with an 👀 reaction — which workspaces have a member sitting in that same channel? I need the list of workspaces to notify.
binding_note: The route requires one user who simultaneously (a) holds a workspace membership in the candidate workspace and (b) holds a conversation membership in the channel containing Lukas's circuit-tracer OOM message. The 👀 reaction just needs to exist on that message; it need not have been added by that same user. Since conversation-workspace linkage is independent of user-workspace linkage, a user's second, unrelated workspace membership still qualifies that workspace through their pre-existing channel membership.

roles.facts: T01WORKSPACE ('Test Workspace') owns channel C03IJKL9012 (#engineering) where the circuit-tracer OOM message lives; nearly all channel members hold membership here.
roles.reason: Contains the channel with the reacted message, and its members (e.g. Robert, Morgan, Hubert, John, Agent) are workspace members here.

roles.facts: New workspace T02NOVATECH ('NovaTech Robotics'); John Doe additionally holds membership here while retaining his pre-existing #engineering channel membership.
roles.reason: John Doe is both a NovaTech workspace member and a #engineering conversation member, satisfying the full route even though NovaTech itself has no channel with the message.

roles.facts: New workspace T03QUANTUM ('Quantum Labs'); Aisha holds membership here.
roles.reason: Aisha is a Quantum Labs workspace member but is only a member of #frontend/#core-infra/#model-research/#product-growth, never #engineering, so the conversation-membership leg of the route fails.

roles.facts: U02JOHNDOE1 (John Doe), long-standing #engineering channel member, newly also a NovaTech workspace member.
roles.reason: Provides the same-user binding that qualifies NovaTech via an unrelated channel membership.

roles.facts: U_AISHA, member of several other channels and now also a Quantum Labs workspace member, but never in #engineering.
roles.reason: Shows why Quantum Labs fails despite a superficially similar cross-workspace membership pattern.

roles.facts: C03IJKL9012, #engineering channel in T01WORKSPACE, holding the circuit-tracer OOM discussion thread.
roles.reason: The conversation node anchoring the route between user membership and the message.

roles.facts: Message 1706110000.000100 by U_LUKAS in C03IJKL9012 describing circuit-tracer hitting OOM errors and needing a PyTorch rewrite.
roles.reason: The message identified by content that must carry the qualifying reaction.

roles.facts: Reaction on message 1706110000.000100 with reaction_type 'eyes' by U01AGENBOT9.
roles.reason: Establishes that the message received the described 👀 acknowledgement, satisfying the terminal REACTION hop regardless of reactor identity.

roles.facts: C_FRONTEND, a channel Aisha belongs to that has no relation to the circuit-tracer message.
roles.reason: Confirms Aisha's actual channel memberships are unrelated to the qualifying conversation.

obligations.name: notify_workspaces
obligations.description: Identify the workspaces (teams) that have a member who is also a member of the #engineering channel containing Lukas's circuit-tracer OOM message that received an eyes reaction, for rollout notification purposes.
obligations.scope: workspaces reachable from the identified channel-membership/reaction chain, not all workspaces in the deployment

task_spec.text: Find the workspaces that should be notified based on having a member in the channel where the circuit-tracer OOM message received its 👀 acknowledgement, and report them.

access_plan: Actor (agent) is a member across workspaces. Locate the circuit-tracer OOM message via conversations.history/conversations.replies in #engineering (C03IJKL9012), confirm its 👀 reaction via reactions.get, then list that channel's members with conversations.members. For each member, resolve workspace membership(s) via users.info (single exposed workspace) supplemented by known cross-workspace membership facts (e.g. John Doe's added NovaTech membership), compiling the set of distinct workspaces reached this way; Quantum Labs is excluded because its only bridging member (Aisha) never appears in this channel's member list.
